en: Fix source-to-installer migration so existing account references, assistant and skill sources, settings, tasks and drafts are retained without copying provider credentials. Existing installer configurations remain unchanged.
Fix a race between checking updates and verifying an installer for activation. Accept UTF-8 BOM in local configuration, and resume matching draft releases safely after interrupted publication.
zh: 修复从源码版转到安装版时未接续原配置的问题：保留已有账号入口、助手与技能来源、设置、任务和草稿，不复制模型服务的登录凭据；已有安装版配置保持不变。
修复检查更新与安装包校验同时发生时的冲突；支持带 UTF-8 BOM 的配置文件，并在发布中断后安全接续同版本的发布草稿。
